description: The file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that implements the LogNode interface, enabling it to display log messages on the UI. It formats log data, including priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and appends it to the TextView, also chaining to the next LogNode if present.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log messages, implementing the LogNode interface. It formats log data and appends it to the view, supporting chaining with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, including priority, tag, message, and throwable, on the UI and chains the log to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder if it is not null, adding a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the given string as a new line to the log view.
